formal_name: Closest-Prior-Art VM-Policy Architectural Comparator and Dependency Ablation Battery
primary_question: Whether a faithful strongest technically supportable implementation of the identified closest-prior-art VM-policy architecture reproduces both the structural-participation consequence and fidelity of GBI without importing the GBI-specific Authorization -> Instantiation Boundary -> ISP -> MRC dependency.
null_hypothesis: The closest-prior-art architecture reproduces both the structural-participation consequence and fidelity of GBI without introduction of the GBI-specific dependency relationship.
alternative_hypothesis: The closest-prior-art architecture does not reproduce those consequences unless the GBI-specific dependency relationship is introduced.
falsification_rule: The GBI-specific dependency hypothesis shall not be regarded as supported if CPA_PRIOR_ART independently reproduces both the instantiated-structural-participation consequence attributed to GBI and the prescribed fidelity requirements under equivalent workload conditions.
hardware_proxy_rule: CUDA timing, utilization, power, energy, temperature, and memory are bounded hardware-stress proxies and shall not independently establish constitutional equivalence or non-equivalence.
negative_result_rule: All valid results shall be preserved irrespective of whether they support, weaken, contradict, or leave unresolved the experimental hypothesis.
